title: L5 guild competition / successional displacement (C-023)
simLoop: runHabitatStep attenuates the insolation feeding herb's Liebig light factor through shrub's own canopy cover (existing Beer–Lambert evaluateLight, reused not duplicated), so a growing shrub canopy lowers herb's HSI and — combined with L3's mortality-as-a-rate — herb biomass can recede from a previously established peak as shrub rises. Zero shrub cover leaves the attenuated value bit-identical to open-sky insolation.
gameLoop: A meadow that shrub moves into stops being a meadow: the pioneer cover that got there first visibly gives ground as the woody canopy closes over it, instead of both persisting at full strength forever in the same cell.
notebookSeed: The shrub that moved in didn't just add to the meadow — it started shading it out. Give it a few more years and you'll see the grass thin under the canopy.
